name: Quran Tafseer API
description: Specialized, lightweight RESTful Quranic exegesis (Tafseer) API providing classical and modern commentaries by renowned scholars in Arabic and multiple languages, indexed by Surah and Ayah number ranges.

endpoints.name: List All Quran Chapters (Surahs)
endpoints.description: Returns list of all 114 Surahs with metadata, IDs, and verse counts.

endpoints.name: List All Available Tafseers
endpoints.description: Returns all available Tafsir editions with their IDs, scholar names, languages, and descriptions (e.g. Tafsir Ibn Kathir, Al-Muyassar, Al-Jalalayn, Al-Sa'di, Al-Baghawi, Al-Qurtubi, Tanweer al-Miqbas).

endpoints.name: Get Verse Tafseer
endpoints.description: Retrieves the commentary text of a single specific verse.

endpoints.name: Get Verse Tafseer Range
endpoints.description: Retrieves commentary for a contiguous range of verses within a single Surah.
